[LTIM.14.2] **What a call refuses.** The engine must raise a
`ComputationError` of kind `DOMAIN` ([LERR.1.4.10]), and abandon the
activation, when a field is outside its range: `month` outside `1..12`, `day`
naming no day of that month in that year, `hour` outside `0..23`, `minute` or
`second` outside `0..59`, or `nanosecond` outside `0..999 999 999`.

A call whose fields are in range and whose value is outside the range of
[LTIM.1.1.5] for a `Time`, or of [LTIM.1.2.2] for a `Date`, must raise
`NOT_REPRESENTABLE` ([LERR.1.4.10]) and never wrap. The engine must compute the
value exactly: where the value is in range, no step of computing it may
overflow.
